summary: Egress Peer Engineering uses Segment Routing and BGP so a controller can choose an egress peer. This document defines MPLS ping and traceroute procedures for checking the segment identifiers it uses, such as PeerNode SIDs.

eli5.summary: When a controller picks which neighbor a packet should leave through, you need a way to test that choice works. This provides the test.

questions: lsp ping for bgp egress peer engineering
how to test epe segment identifiers
